newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion denies has Instru plans.
newsitem.headline: Orion denies has Instru plans.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy on Thursday denied newspaper reports it was considering a merger with health care equipment maker Instrumentarium Oy.

"We announce that none of our company's administrative bodies have made any unpublished decisions on these issues. The company has no plans regarding them and the matter has not even been discussed in our administrative bodies," it said in a statement.
Two Finnish dailies on Thursday quoted Juhani Aho, the new chairman of Orion's supervisory board, as saying that the cross-ownership between the two companies would be reviewed.

"According to Aho all options are still possible at this stage: the situation can be left unchanged, the cross-ownership can be dismantled so that the firms sell each others' shares or cross-ownership can be deepened, possibly all the way to a merger," Helsingin Sanomat said.
Orion owns 27 percent of votes in Instrumentarium, which in turn is Orion's biggest single owner with nearly 10 percent of votes.
